class.name: LineEdit
class.brief_description: A control for editing one line of text.
class.description: Supports a caret, text selection, and horizontal scrolling. RestoreEditState restores an edit state; other text editing methods are not exposed to C# yet.

method.name: RestoreEditState
method.description: Restores the text, caret, and horizontal scroll position, and clears the selection. Text changes notify the text change callback. If the text differs and editing cannot begin, nothing is changed.
method.param: The caret position in text characters, starting at zero. Clamped to the text length.
The horizontal scroll offset in local control units. The text layout may adjust it to keep the caret visible.
